name: Make simple jewelry
blurb: Wire wrapping and beading need almost no equipment and produce wearable results in the first session. It is also a gateway to metalwork if you want it.
gear: Craft wire in a couple of gauges
steps: Learn to open and close jump rings correctly, twisting sideways rather than pulling apart, so they stay round and strong.
Learn the simple loop and the wrapped loop — the wrapped loop is the one that will not pull open, and it is the foundation of most designs.
Learn to make earrings from headpins and beads, which teaches consistent loop sizing.
Learn basic wire wrapping around a stone or a cabochon.
Learn to make a chain from jump rings, then a simple clasp.
Learn to finish properly: tuck every wire end so nothing scratches the wearer.
tips: Wire work-hardens as you bend it. Too many corrections and it snaps — plan before you bend.
Sharp wire ends are the difference between handmade and homemade. File and tuck them all.
proof: A matched pair of earrings and a bracelet, well finished, that survive regular wear.
